      "sentence": "His exertional dyspnea has progressed to orthopnea, and examination shows bibasilar crackles and bilateral leg edema.",

      "question_quote": "he feels similarly short of breath when lying down",
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "This pattern suggests heart failure with both pulmonary and systemic congestion.",
      "grounding": "passages",

      "passage_ids": ["Pharmacology_Katzung:000835", "First_Aid_Step2:000015"]
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Nightly alcohol use and two prior admissions for “the shakes,” which may have been alcohol withdrawal, suggest sustained heavy alcohol exposure.",
      "grounding": "none",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Chronic heavy alcohol exposure can directly injure the myocardium, causing a dilated cardiomyopathy with impaired contraction.",
      "grounding": "none",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "The prior catheterization showed an enlarged heart despite patent coronary arteries.",
      "grounding": "question",
      "question_quote": "a moderately enlarged heart but patent coronary arteries",
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Patent coronaries when enlargement was already present make ischemic cardiomyopathy less likely, and the alcohol history favors toxic cardiomyopathy over isolated diastolic heart failure, although no ejection fraction is provided.",
